tools.name: monitor_wallet
tools.description: Monitor a wallet for balance changes and new USDC/ERC-20 activity. Recurring paid primitive; repeat about every 60 seconds while monitoring is active. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: Canonical wallet balance for Base or Ethereum. Returns native ETH and USDC balances for one address and is suitable for recurring wallet and treasury polling. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: wallet_activity
tools.description: Read recent wallet ERC-20/USDC activity with cursor state for recurring payment and deposit monitoring. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: gas_price
tools.description: Canonical current EVM base fee in gwei for Base or Ethereum, for recurring transaction timing and execution checks. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.
